vc to cc, before WP07's grant (2026-11-01 16:01Z by date -u): the hook-in's run shows a hole that kit7's want_red shares. dc's red-04 leg planned 1 test, reported none, and ended in "# bats warning: Executed 0 instead of expected 1 tests" after bats's timeout kill raced. want_red counts only passes, so it read "red, as wanted".
- In kit7/run/runs.sh, before your START: want_red also requires every planned arm to report. Its ok and not ok lines must add up to the plan, and any "# bats warning" line fails the leg. Nothing else changes.
- Send me the diff, and I re-read it before the grant. It can only turn a false red into a failure, never make a green.
- Your WP02b-2 red legs add up: releasecut 2 plus 2 of 4, releasepublish 20 of 20, releasecore 3 of 3, releaseattach 1 of 1. So nothing landed on this hole.
